abilities.name: Sudden Strike
abilities.rawDescription:
Rounds 2, 4, 6, and 8: 25% chance to apply Weakened to 1 enemy within adjacency. Double the chance to 50% if the target is afflicted with Bleed. Weakened reduces the target's Damage Dealt by -10%.

Rounds 2, 4, 5, 6, and 8: deal Physical Damage to 2 enemies within adjacency at a +40% Damage Rate. Physical Damage is increased by the attacker's Strength and mitigated by the target's Instinct.

The Weakened target selection and Physical Damage target selection are independent. The screenshot does not state that the Weakened target must overlap a damaged target.

abilities.name: Warrior's Resilience
abilities.rawDescription: At Dragon Level 16+ while Arrax is deployed in Vanguard: reduce Arrax Damage Received by -8%. Increase Tactical Damage Dealt of the Left Flank ally by +16%. The Damage Received reduction is self-only.

abilities.name: Headlong into Danger
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 4 for 4 rounds: increase Arrax Strength by +25%, Initiative by +10%, and Physical Damage Dealt by +25%. Also increase Arrax Physical Damage Received and reduce Arrax Instinct. All effects are self-only. The penalties are not Vulnerable or Weakened. At Habit Level 5 the displayed penalties become zero while the positive effects remain.

Progression table (Physical Damage Received; Instinct):
Habit Level 1: +10%; -40%
Habit Level 2: +8%; -32%
Habit Level 3: +6%; -24%
Habit Level 4: +3%; -12%
Habit Level 5: 0%; 0%

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Stone Bulwark
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of combat until end of combat: reduce Tactical Damage Received and Fire Damage Received of the same 2 other allies in any lane. In a three-dragon formation, this targets both other formation members; no adjacency is required.

The prose displays -2%; the Habit Level 1 table displays -2.5%. Both values are retained.

Progression table (Tactical and Fire Damage Received):
Habit Level 1: -2.5%
Habit Level 2: -3%
Habit Level 3: -3.5%
Habit Level 4: -4.25%
Habit Level 5: -5%

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Adaptive Guard
abilities.rawDescription:
When leading Archers, at the start of Round 4 reduce Tactical Damage Received of 3 allies in any lane for 4 rounds. When leading Shieldbearers, at the start of Round 4 reduce Fire Damage Received of 3 allies in any lane for 4 rounds. These are separate troop-gated branches. Formation Builder has no selected troop context, so neither branch is treated as active or scored and neither creates a utilization penalty.

Progression table (Damage Received reduction):
Habit Level 1: -9%
Habit Level 2: -10.8%
Habit Level 3: -12.6%
Habit Level 4: -15.3%
Habit Level 5: -18%

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Fire Ward
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of combat: grant Arrax 1 stack of Fire Ward and grant 1 other adjacent ally 1 stack of Fire Ward. Start of each round, if the selected target ally retreated in the previous round, grant Arrax 1 additional stack of Fire Ward. Each stack reduces Fire Damage Received and lasts until end of combat. The maximum stack count is not stated; no cap is inferred. The ally receives the initial stack, while subsequent retreat-triggered stacks are granted to Arrax. Fire Ward is a named beneficial status and is not offensive Fire Damage support.

Progression table (Fire Damage Received per stack):
Habit Level 1: -5%
Habit Level 2: -6%
Habit Level 3: -7%
Habit Level 4: -8.5%
Habit Level 5: -10%

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Turn the Line
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 4 for 4 rounds: increase Physical Damage Received of 2 enemies within adjacency. This is direct typed Physical Damage Received amplification, not the named Vulnerable status.

Progression table (Physical Damage Received):
Habit Level 1: +9%
Habit Level 2: +11.7%
Habit Level 3: +14.4%
Habit Level 4: +18%
Habit Level 5: +22.5%

Power: 250 / 580 / 1000 / 1600 / 2300
